messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: HIGH - gpu-concurrency-surge in us-west-2. Queueing >30s observed for inference.v1 endpoints. Paging oncall @jason. Auto-fallback to smaller models triggered for some customers.

jason: ack, I'm on it. jumping into logs and HPA. Will coordinate with infra to limit impact.

maria: sending along recent customer error spikes — looks like three tenants hit >25% error rate around 12:14 UTC. link: https://redwood.internal/observability/alerts/2302107654

jason: quick checks:
```
kubectl get hpa -n inference gpu-pool-hpa -o yaml
# current replicas: 6, desired: 12, cpu%: 95
```
Looks like HPA lagged behind sudden burst. Starting manual scale to buy time.

jason: /run: terraform apply -target=module.gpu_pool.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu -var 'desired_capacity=12' (manual bump in org pool for 30m)

kevin: i'll take ownership for the remediation and handoff after immediate mitigation. kevin -> oncall lead for next shift.

sara: CS note — two large enterprise customers reported slowdowns and one opened a ticket. They asked for ETA and whether requests were lost. I'll prepare a short customer note once we have impact numbers. :+1:

jason: mitigation timeline: manual scale succeeded, tail latency dropped to ~80ms for routed smaller models, heavier models still queue ~2-5s while new instances warm. will keep scaling until autoscaler catches up.

lee: observed spikes in concurrent LLM sessions from a single tenant — possible traffic surge from batch job. forwarding raw request ids to kevin.

kevin: found a traffic pattern — large batch inference job started in us-west region and pinned many long-lived sessions. action plan:
- short term: throttle that job via rate-limiter (applied, reduced concurrency from 60 -> 6)
- mid term: tune HPA to consider custom metric (request concurrency) in addition to cpu
- long term: add soft per-customer concurrency caps and better backpressure handling

jason: notes for post-incident followup: we need an AFTER-ACTION doc with owners, timeline, and rollback triggers for autoscaler tuning. I'm creating INF-8421 to track work.

support-bot: created ticket INF-8421: "us-west gpu concurrency surge - afteraction and infra changes" assigned to kevin, jason; priority P2.

maria: customer impact summary for initial report (prelim): 3 enterprise tenants saw degraded tail latency 12:14 - 12:42 UTC, 1 tenant reported transient errors (retries succeeded). No data exfiltration, no model divergence observed.

kevin: proposed immediate action items (owners):
- add concurrency metric to HPA policy (owner: kevin)
- implement soft per-customer concurrency cap (owner: eng-platform/lee)
- postmortem + RCA doc + timeline (owner: jason)
- customer communication draft (owner: sara)
- runbook update for manual scale steps and when to trigger reserved capacity (owner: eng-sre)

jason: scheduling postmortem: propose Wed 10:00 PT (invite to eng-runtime, eng-sre, support, product). I'll create calendar invite and attach INF-8421.

sara: will prepare customer-facing summary and coordinate with account teams before postmortem.

kevin: I'll work the JIRA and drop a short remediation tracker in the ops board. Please add any logs or traces to the ticket.

jason: final check: confirm followups by EOD today:
- kevin: HPA metric proposal PR
- lee: initial per-customer cap design doc + perf impact notes
- sara: customer note draft
- eng-sre: runbook PR for manual scale

maria: thanks team. marking thread as 'assigned' and linking support tickets to customer issues.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status -> mitigated (manual scale + throttling), owner -> kevin, followups tracked in INF-8421.

support-bot: added comment to INF-8421: "customer outreach in progress, CS will post update after review."

kevin: leaving notes in case handoff needed: when autoscaler re-evaluates, ensure signal uses request_concurrency metric AND cpu, set min_replicas to 6 for gpu-pool in us-west during peak hours.

jason: thanks all. will drop the invite and preliminary RCA doc before the postmortem. :thumbsup:
